summary.intent: Run the GSD 'discuss phase' workflow for Phase 66 (API Schema Cutover, Publish Gate, and Tombstone) to surface and resolve implementation gray areas, then produce a CONTEXT.md that downstream research/planning agents can act on without re-asking the user.
summary.outcome: Eleven decisions were locked across schema migration strategy, column shape, CAS publish gate, tombstone/resolve semantics, invite slimming, grant uniqueness, permission column, TEE column boundary, revoke semantics, and test proof approach; 66-CONTEXT.md and 66-DISCUSSION-LOG.md were written and committed.

repo: share_invites carries encrypted_child_keys jsonb that must be dropped; encrypted_key becomes the single ephemeral-wrapped root readKey

shares entity currently has (sharer_id, recipient_id, ipns_name) partial-unique with encrypted_key/encrypted_ipns_key; root_node_id/root_ipns_name/root_generation and readDescriptorRef/writeDescriptorRef need to be added
Ed25519 pubkey must be recovered from k51 IPNS name via publicKeyFromIpnsName — the public_key column on ipns_records must not be retained (caused two Phase-60 regressions)
ipns_records rename from folder_ipns is part of this cutover; share_keys table and addShareKeys logic are deleted outright
apps/api already has a supertest e2e harness at apps/api/test/*.e2e-spec.ts
Tombstoned publish returns 410 with structured body { error: 'IPNS_TOMBSTONED', ipnsName } flowing through pnpm api:generate into @cipherbox/api-client
Hard-delete on revoke preferred over soft-delete: revoked_at column dropped entirely; stale ECIES key material at rest has no consumer post-rotation and conflicts with zero-DB-crypto direction
permission column on shares dropped in this phase; TEE columns on ipns_records stay as-is (Phase 67 boundary)
Concurrent-CAS race test requires a deterministic forcing mechanism through the real client path (barrier or temp axios interceptor) — all sdk-e2e proofs go through real client→API round-trip

code.finding: Newly created CONTEXT.md capturing all 11 locked decisions for Phase 66
Discussion log written alongside CONTEXT.md per GSD workflow convention

workflow: GSD discuss-phase workflow: init phase-op first, scout codebase, surface gray areas interactively, deep-dive selected ones, write CONTEXT.md from template, write discussion log, then commit
Decisions that override the AI recommendation should be noted explicitly so planners see the delta
DATABASE_EVOLUTION_PROTOCOL reversibility discipline is explicitly accepted-to-waive in greenfield/staging-wipe contexts; this must be documented in CONTEXT.md not just assumed
Memory writes during a session (feedback on DB crypto minimization / hard-delete preference) should update both the memory file and MEMORY.md index atomically

friction: todo cross-reference matches were mostly keyword noise — only one item (rotation grant-threading follow-up) was genuinely Phase-66-relevant, requiring manual filtering
The MEMORY.md edit required two sequential Edit calls because the initial edit needed to be verified against the current file state before appending

Phase 67: richer ipns_records status enum beyond tombstoned_at + generation
Phase 68/69: live rotation→grant re-mint/revoke caller flow (DATA-04 caller side deferred)
Q3 split-authority: writeDescriptorRef nullable path deferred to Q3
